note: Every occurrence is ATTRIBUTED, never failed on. A gate that reds on a rounded corner is red forever and gets muted inside a week, and the corner might be a phone's corner.
for_ui: THE CHEAPEST WIN FIRST: 15 phantom --skin-* uses, 0 declarations. Declare them once and they become real tokens, and the act-two skin swap becomes possible. Today swapping the skin changes nothing because there is nothing to swap.
THEN THE SCALE: 18 distinct radii and 14 distinct shadow recipes. Five border widths is already a scale; those two are not. The trade's rule is that every value comes from your own short list.
693 typed-in-place values is the actionable list, and it is what the ratchet holds.
171 of 218 font declarations resolve to bare monospace. The face is decided, embedded and first in the stack on all 40 chrome elements; it is simply not asked for everywhere else.
9 of 40 chrome elements carry capitals TYPED INTO THE TEXT rather than applied with CSS. A reader cannot turn those off and a screen reader may spell them out.
good_news_measured: ZERO trend fonts (Inter, Poppins, Space Grotesk, Geist, Roboto, DM Sans) in any of the three surfaces.
BohemiaMono is embedded as woff2 at two weights, loads in the real browser, and is FIRST in the resolved stack on all 40 chrome elements. The biggest tell on every published list is answered.
ZERO CSS text-transform:uppercase on the chrome.
ZERO of 42 controls break when a reader widens letter spacing to the WCAG 0.12em, with a planted chip proving the test can detect breakage.
